description: One-stop administrative workspace for lightning-fast inverter and battery inventory distribution, tracking stock inward from suppliers, outward to dealers, serial number traceability, and brand/model analytics without login friction.
target_audience: Battery distributors, warehouse managers, and wholesale operations
emotional_tone: Precise, authoritative, command-center efficient, robust industrial

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism, Precision & Industrial Control)

surface_strategies.card: bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:border-[#FF5722]/50 transition-colors
surface_strategies.header: bg-[#0F1115]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#30363D] sticky top-0 z-50

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Exceeds WCAG AAA for text against dark industrial background
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive and informational elements include kebab-case data-testid attributes

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NO LOGIN REQUIRED - one-stop admin workspace as requested by user.
Ensure lightning-fast stock inward and outward entry with quick-add master records.
